note.text: Most organizations plan for AI by extrapolating last quarter's capability forward a notch, which guarantees surprise. A sharper habit is writing a concrete scenario of what the tools can do a year or two out, specific enough to be wrong, then checking it against reality every few months. The exercise forces decisions that are otherwise postponed until a crisis makes them urgent. Treat the scenario as a working draft, not a prophecy, and update it faster than the technology moves.
